name: figo-mac-driver
description: FigoBooks local printer bridge — connects thermal printers to the FigoBooks web app

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const run = (cmd) => spawnSync(cmd, ['assets/gen_icons.py'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32' }); const cmds = process.platform === 'win32' ? ['python', 'python3', 'py'] : ['python3', 'python']; for (const cmd of cmds) { const r = run(cmd); if (!r.error && r.status === 0) break; } process.exit(0);"
scripts.build:dist: npm run build:extension && npm run build:pkg:mac
